insights.topic: Verified purchase data vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Crinkl has confirmed $2.17M in beta GMV across 37,576+ receipts — each one a cryptographically verified purchase event, not an inferred intent signal. For brands paying $5+ CPM to guess who might buy, this is the structural alternative: deterministic proof of transaction at the moment it happens.

Grocery-supermarkets (1,402 receipts, $79K) and restaurants-dining (1,229 receipts, $49K) together represent 49% of 14-day receipt volume — a stable share across the full monitoring window. Brands in CPG, QSR, and food retail are looking at a verified-purchase panel already skewed toward high-frequency, high-loyalty spend categories.

insights.topic: Basket size compression signals category shift, not demand softness
insights.insight: Average basket has moved from ~$65 to ~$53 across the monitoring window — a compression traceable to growing grocery and dining share, both inherently lower-ticket than department-store or home-improvement purchases. CMOs should read this as a category-mix story, not a signal of weakening consumer engagement.

insights.topic: Competing brand pairs confirm category-level reach
insights.insight: The Home Depot and Lowe's are simultaneously present on the brand leaderboard; CVS Pharmacy and Walgreens entered within 24 hours of each other. When two direct competitors surface in the same verified-receipt network at the same time, it confirms the panel has genuine category density — not single-brand dominance that would limit competitive conquest use cases.

insights.topic: DKIM verification spans retail, digital commerce, and SaaS
insights.insight: Confirmed receipt sources include Amazon, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, OpenAI, and Suno alongside Walmart, Target, and Costco. For CMOs targeting digitally-native or subscription buyers, this cross-channel verification footprint means purchase attribution isn't confined to physical retail — it covers the full modern commerce stack.

insights.topic: 18 active metros, 30 category/metro cells — early but structured geo footprint
insights.insight: Coverage is running across 30 category/metro cells in 18 metro areas, with 8 active predicates governing distribution. The footprint is early-stage but deliberately structured — brands evaluating cookieless targeting alternatives should note that geographic and category targeting logic is already operational, not theoretical.
